name: Sarah Huckabee Sanders
summary: Sarah Elizabeth Huckabee Sanders (née  Huckabee; born August 13, 1982) is an American politician serving as the 47th governor of Arkansas since 2023. Sanders is the daughter of Ambassador Mike Huckabee, who was the 44th governor of Arkansas. A member of the Republican Party, she joined Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign, then served as 31st White House press secretary from 2017 to 2019, the third woman in the role.
